BigQuery Schema.name: event_date
BigQuery Schema.description: The date when the event was logged (YYYYMMDD format in the registered timezone of your app).

BigQuery Schema.name: event_timestamp
BigQuery Schema.description: The time (in microseconds, UTC) when the event was received by Google Analytics.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_ts
BigQuery Schema.description: The timestamp (event_timestamp in seconds, UTC) when the event was logged. used for BQ time based partitioning.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_name
BigQuery Schema.description: The name of the event.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The name of the event parameter.

fields.name: string_value
fields.description: If the event parameter is represented by a string, such as a URL or campaign name, it is populated in this field.

fields.name: int_value
fields.description: If the event parameter is represented by an integer, it is populated in this field.

fields.name: float_value
fields.description: If the event parameter is represented by a floating point value, it is populated in this field. This field is not currently in use.

fields.name: double_value
fields.description: If the event parameter is represented by a double value, it is populated in this field.

fields.name: value
fields.description: A record containing the event parameter's value.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_params
BigQuery Schema.description: The event_params RECORD can store campaign-level and contextual event parameters as well as any user-defined event parameters. The event_params RECORD is repeated for each key that is associated with an event.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_previous_timestamp
BigQuery Schema.description: The time (in microseconds, UTC) when the previous event happened.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_value_in_usd
BigQuery Schema.description: The currency-converted value (in USD) of the event's "value" parameter.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_bundle_sequence_id
BigQuery Schema.description: The sequential ID of the bundle in which these events were uploaded.

BigQuery Schema.name: event_server_timestamp_offset
BigQuery Schema.description: Timestamp offset between collection time and upload time in micros.

BigQuery Schema.name: user_id
BigQuery Schema.description: The unique ID assigned to a user.

BigQuery Schema.name: user_pseudo_id
BigQuery Schema.description: The pseudonymous id (e.g., app instance ID) for the user. A unique identifier that is assigned to a user when they first open the app or visit the site.

fields.name: analytics_storage
fields.description: Whether Analytics storage is enabled for the user.

fields.name: ads_storage
fields.description: Whether ad targeting is enabled for a user.

fields.name: uses_transient_token
fields.description: Whether a web user has denied Analytics storage and the developer has enabled measurement without cookies based on transient tokens in server data.

BigQuery Schema.name: privacy_info
BigQuery Schema.description: The privacy_info fields contain information based on the consent status of a user when consent mode is enabled.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The name of the user property.

fields.name: string_value
fields.description: The string value of the user property.

fields.name: int_value
fields.description: The integer value of the user property.

fields.name: float_value
fields.description: This field is currently unused.

fields.name: double_value
fields.description: The double value of the user property.

fields.name: set_timestamp_micros
fields.description: The time (in microseconds) at which the user property was last set.

fields.name: value
fields.description: A record for the user property value.

BigQuery Schema.name: user_properties
BigQuery Schema.description: The user_properties RECORD contains any user properties that you have set. It is repeated for each key that is associated with a user.

BigQuery Schema.name: user_first_touch_timestamp
BigQuery Schema.description: The time (in microseconds) at which the user first opened the app or visited the site.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: The Lifetime Value (revenue) of the user. This field is not populated in intraday tables.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The Lifetime Value (currency) of the user. This field is not populated in intraday tables.

BigQuery Schema.name: user_ltv
BigQuery Schema.description: The user_ltv RECORD contains Lifetime Value information about the user. This RECORD is not populated in intraday tables.

fields.name: category

fields.name: web_info

BigQuery Schema.name: device

fields.name: continent

fields.name: country

fields.name: install_source
fields.description: The store that installed the app.

BigQuery Schema.name: app_info
BigQuery Schema.description: The app_info RECORD contains information about the app in which the event was initiated.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the marketing campaign that first acquired the user. This field is not populated in intraday tables.

fields.name: medium
fields.description: Name of the medium (paid search, organic search, email, etc.) that first acquired the user. This field is not populated in intraday tables.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Name of the network that first acquired the user. This field is not populated in intraday tables.

BigQuery Schema.name: traffic_source
BigQuery Schema.description: The traffic_source RECORD contains information about the traffic source that first acquired the user. This record is not populated in intraday tables.

BigQuery Schema.name: stream_id
BigQuery Schema.description: The numeric ID of the data stream from which the event originated.

BigQuery Schema.name: platform
BigQuery Schema.description: The data stream platform (Web, IOS or Android) from which the event originated.

fields.name: total_item_quantity
fields.description: Total number of items in this event, which is the sum of items.quantity.

fields.description: Purchase revenue of this event, represented in USD with standard unit. Populated for purchase event only.

fields.description: Purchase revenue of this event, represented in local currency with standard unit. Populated for purchase event only.

fields.name: refund_value_in_usd

fields.name: refund_value

fields.name: shipping_value_in_usd
fields.description: The shipping cost in this event, represented in USD with standard unit.

fields.name: shipping_value
fields.description: The shipping cost in this event, represented in local currency.

fields.name: tax_value_in_usd
fields.description: The tax value in this event, represented in USD with standard unit.

fields.name: tax_value
fields.description: The tax value in this event, represented in local currency with standard unit.

fields.name: unique_items
fields.description: The number of unique items in this event, based on item_id, item_name, and item_brand.

fields.name: transaction_id

BigQuery Schema.name: ecommerce
BigQuery Schema.description: This ecommerce RECORD contains information about any ecommerce events that have been setup on a website or app.

fields.name: item_id
fields.description: The ID of the item.

fields.name: item_name
fields.description: The name of the item.

fields.name: item_category5
fields.description: The sub category of the item.

fields.name: price_in_usd
fields.description: The price of the item, in USD with standard unit.

fields.description: The price of the item in local currency.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The quantity of the item. Quantity set to 1 if not specified.

fields.name: item_revenue

fields.name: item_refund_in_usd
fields.description: The refund value of this item, calculated as price_in_usd * quantity. It is populated for refund events only, in USD with standard unit.

fields.name: item_refund
fields.description: The refund value of this item, calculated as price * quantity. It is populated for refund events only, in local currency with standard unit.

fields.name: coupon

fields.name: affiliation
fields.description: A product affiliation to designate a supplying company or brick and mortar store location.

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: The location associated with the item.

fields.name: item_list_id

fields.name: item_list_name
fields.description: The name of the list in which the item was presented to the user.

fields.name: item_list_index

fields.name: creative_name

fields.name: creative_slot

BigQuery Schema.description: The items RECORD contains information about items included in an event. It is repeated for each item.
